entry.note: PDF verified: 'On the Classification of Topological Field Theories (Draft)' by Jacob Lurie, arXiv:0905.0465. Matches references.ts metadata. Cited in QOU for Lurie's TQFT classification.

relevance.rationale: Join CORRECT (arXiv:0905.0465v1, 'On the Classification of Topological Field Theories (Draft)', matching the registered entry). Not in the working tree on this branch; recovered from intake commit 8093f698c4, sha matches. Cited at folio/quantum-observable-universe/quantum-observable-universes/tqft-context.ts:6 (a cites array alongside atiyah1988, baez1995, freed2010, kock2004, turaev2010, witten1988 - appropriate background for a TQFT-context block) and at glossary-descent.lean:17 plus lean/QOU/Glossary.lean:136,149. The glossary sites are the weak ones: the DescentData structure they annotate carries a level and a restriction_exists : Prop and is explicitly mapped to CategoryTheory.EffectiveEpiFamily / descent data in a fibered category. That is ordinary descent, not the cobordism hypothesis; this document is an expository account of the cobordism hypothesis and does not supply the descent-data notion being glossed. Supporting, not core: the folio consumes it as background for 'TQFT and higher categories', and no result of it (the cobordism hypothesis, the (infinity,n)-categorical framework, complete Segal spaces) is used.
